text:
scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('scripts').glob('*.sh')):
    text = p.read_text()
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    if not lines:
        raise SystemExit(f'{p}: empty file')
    if lines[0].strip() != '#!/bin/bash':
        raise SystemExit(f'{p}: unexpected first line: {lines[0]!r}')
    if len(lines) > 1 and lines[1].strip() == 'set -euo pipefail':
        continue
    lines.insert(1, 'set -euo pipefail\n')
    p.write_text(''.join(lines))
    print(f'updated {p}')
PY
